plan.root_cause: The suggestion list items have tabindex='0', making them focusable. When the list is open, focus lands on the first option, so pressing Tab cycles through the list items instead of moving to the next form field.
plan.repair_strategy: Remove the tabindex attribute from option elements so they are not part of the tab order. Keyboard navigation via arrow keys remains functional through the widget's internal index management and aria-activedescendant, and screen readers can still announce options via role='option'.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: When the suggestion list is visible, a single Tab press will move focus from the city combobox to the next form field (#dietary), while arrow keys continue to navigate options and Enter selects the highlighted option.
functional_risks: Removing tabindex may affect legacy Talkback reliance on tabindex=0 for option discovery; however, the combination of role='option' and aria-activedescendant should maintain accessibility.
Ensure that assistive technologies still announce options correctly when they gain active descentancy.
verification_requirements: After typing 'Ber' in the city field, pressing Tab must focus the #dietary input.
Arrow Up/Down must change the highlighted option (visual styling and aria-activedescendant).
Enter must select the highlighted option and close the list.
Screen reader should still read each option as it becomes active.
